boundary.rationale: Rounded construction envelope contains the traced completed traverses, near-base work and local station operating areas. Margin is a design allowance, not a historical limit. Distant mountains remain a separate non-playable backdrop.

frame.conversion: Source Plate Carree x=R*longitude,y=R*latitude; subtract LM then multiply east by cos(LM latitude). x=east,z=-north in game.
frame.note: Source decimal precision is retained, not a claim of centimetre accuracy. Source near-base layers can disagree by tens of metres; photograph geometry remains interpreted.

source.author: PDS Geosciences Apollo Analyst Notebook; traverse traced by Phil Stooke from LROC tracks, surface photos and descriptions
